_comment: Track presets for select_tracked.py. Each maps a name to a selector resolved against the committed market snapshot (full_item_list.json): 'all' selects every marketable item (guarded -- confirmation required); 'main' selects a whole main category; 'main'+'sub' selects one category; 'set' selects a named set from track_sets.json. Main/sub are BDO market taxonomy codes (e.g. accessories are main 20: ring 20:1, necklace 20:2, earring 20:3, belt 20:4; buff consumables are 55:6).
